issue.title: Sub-project cascade for project blocking and the project pull-in
issue.description: A blocked project's sub-projects (project notes whose `parent:` names it, recursively) are Blocked too: their `^prj` and every open resident are `[?]` and tagged `#prj_is_blocked`. `bob task reconcile` derives this and reverses it when the ancestor's reasons clear. The Task Card (Ctrl+Shift+P) applies and reverses it in the same gesture. Every other engine reads a tagged `^prj` as an inherited reason, so nothing links, recovers, or pulls in a cascade-blocked task. Closing a sub-project's `^prj` that leaves its parent with no open work pulls the parent's `^prj` in as Next (§12.10 trigger (c)), both in bob capture and in Obsidian.
